evals.name: publication-evidence-boundary
evals.prompt: Edit this finished documentation section against its source notes. Preserve its document form and useful verification detail. Return the edited section only. Do not use tools.
evals.expected_output: An edited documentation section retaining its heading and configuration instruction, correcting the attempt count, retaining the scoped first-person observation, and removing unsupported rollout and production claims.

expectations.text: The default remains 3 retries after the first attempt (four total if stated); the local stub observation stays explicitly local and does not become production evidence.
The output makes no successful production recovery, zero-loss, or Friday rollout assertion.

The Retry limits heading and configuration instruction remain, useful first-person test evidence survives, and the worth-noting/contrast/that-said scaffolding is removed without turning the section into a chat reply.

evals.name: conversation-useful-first-person
evals.prompt: Give this finished reply a final editing pass using the context. Return only the revised reply. Do not use tools.
evals.expected_output: A concise reply keeping the local reproduction and the author's qualified judgment that the patch may address the reset path, preserving the unrun-patch limit, and removing the unsupported clearing mechanism, fix, and promise.

expectations.text: The author still owns the local reproduction and the unrun patch observation in useful first-person wording.

The patch assessment stays a judgment about the reset path. The output removes or flags the claim that the patch clears a stale connection before retrying: that mechanism appears only in the draft, not the supplied evidence. No tested patch or production outcome is asserted.
The reply addresses whether support can call it fixed from the available evidence, removes the tonight promise and canned opener/closer, and stays a conversational reply.

evals.name: batch-content-led-variation
evals.prompt: Edit these three finished replies together. Preserve their order, individual purposes, and the --- separators. Return only the edited batch. Do not use tools.
evals.expected_output: Three concise replies shaped by their respective correction, bounded test evidence, and pending decision, with repetitive framing removed and no forced padding or new commitments.

expectations.text: There are three replies in the same order with --- separators, each preserving its own point, without importing a fact or ask from a neighboring thread.
The CSV result remains fixture/local only; the launch date remains unchosen and Tuesday or Thursday remains the one requested decision.
Repeated worth-noting openings and where-it-matters closers are removed; the replies vary where their content calls for it without arbitrary length differences, invented details, or unnecessary asks.

evals.name: intentional-form-and-quote
evals.prompt: Edit the surrounding prose in this finished guide excerpt. Keep the required labels, quotation, code block, and two numbered instructions verbatim. Return only the edited excerpt. Do not use tools.
evals.expected_output: A light prose edit retaining protected spans byte for byte, dropping gratuitous surrounding boilerplate, and preserving the fixture-only scope.

expectations.text: The literal labels Setup: and Observation:, the quoted words and enclosing quotation marks, the complete code block, and the two numbered instructions remain verbatim. The prose after the labels and introducing the quotation may be edited while preserving its facts.
The wrapper worth-noting and power-of-testing boilerplate is removed while the section remains a training guide; matching words inside the quotation are retained.
The observed exit 1 stays attached to the fixture; no production outcome is introduced.

evals.name: no-change
evals.prompt: Check this finished reply against the supplied facts and edit only if needed. Return only the final reply. Do not use tools.

expectations.text: The final reply preserves the draft wording exactly, apart from its trailing newline.
The response contains only the reply, with no heading, checklist, rationale, or claim that an editing audit was completed.
The local fixture success and unchecked deployment remain distinct, with no additional test or deployment outcome.

evals.name: missing-material-evidence
evals.prompt: Edit this finished customer update against the supplied context. Return the supported wording and flag any material fact that still needs confirmation. Do not use tools.
evals.expected_output: A supported merged-patch statement plus a concrete confirmation gap about recovery, without certifying or denying recovery, inventing a next action, or making the customer decode internal lane/gate jargon.

expectations.text: The response identifies whether all queued exports were recovered as still needing confirmation; it neither certifies nor denies that recovery and does not silently drop the customer's central question.
The merged-patch fact remains as usable customer wording; the response removes internal lane/gate jargon and the canned closer.
The response adds no actor, deadline, commitment, or unsupported resolution to fill the recovery gap.
